in_hebrew.name: כריסטופורוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם כריסטופורוס מקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו נושא את המשיח. הוא מורכב משני מילים: כריסטוס, שפירושו המשיח, ופורוס, שפירושו נושא. השם כריסטופורוס הוא שם נוצרי שמשמעותו הוא הנושא את המשיח או מי שנושא את ישוע המשיח בלבו.

in_greek.name: Χριστόφορος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Χριστόφορος είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει τον φέροντα τον Χριστό. Είναι σύνθετο όνομα από το Χριστός, που σημαίνει ο Μεσσίας, και το φορός, που σημαίνει ο φέρων. Το όνομα Χριστόφορος είναι χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει αυτός που φέρει τον Χριστό ή αυτός που έχει τον Ιησού Χριστό στην καρδιά του.

in_latin.name: Christophoros
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Christophoros origine Graecum habet et significat Christum ferens. Compositum est ex duobus verbis: Christus, quod significat Messiam, et phoros, quod significat ferens. Nomen Christophoros est nomen Christianum quod significat eum qui Christum fert in corde suo.

in_english.name: Christophoros
in_english.meaning: bearer of Christ, one who carries Christ
in_english.long_meaning: The name Christophoros originates from Greek roots, meaning 'bearer of Christ' or 'one who carries Christ'. It is a compound name derived from Christos (Χριστός), meaning 'anointed one' or 'Messiah', and phoros (φόρος), meaning 'bearer' or 'carrier'. In Christian tradition, Christophoros symbolizes one who bears or carries Christ in their heart, reflecting a deep spiritual connection and devotion to Jesus Christ. Historically, the name has been associated with Saint Christopher, a 3rd-century martyr and patron saint of travelers, further solidifying its significance in Christian culture.

data.cultural_impact: Christophoros is a common Greek name that has been in use since ancient times. Its Christian meaning, 'Christ-bearer', is derived from the Greek legend of a hermit named Christophoros who carried the baby Jesus on his shoulders across a river to protect Him from harm. This story symbolizes selflessness, kindness, and devotion, and it has been passed down through generations as a reminder of the importance of helping others.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Christophoros carries a deep spiritual significance. It represents the belief that each of us has the power to carry the love and teachings of Christ into the world. By living out the teachings of Jesus, we become Christ-bearers and share His light and hope with those around us. The name Christophoros is a constant reminder of our responsibility to love and serve others, and to spread the message of Christ in our daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Christophoros, meaning "Christ-bearer," symbolizes the Christian belief in carrying the burden of Christ in one's life and embodying His love and compassion towards others. This name reinforces the call to follow Christ's teachings and serve as a beacon of hope and salvation to those in need.
